answer.justification: Chronic high-dose analgesic use (acetaminophen plus aspirin) causes analgesic nephropathy with renal papillary necrosis. Sloughed papillae can cause acute ureteral obstruction, producing colicky flank pain and gross hematuria, with proteinuria from chronic tubulointerstitial damage. Absence of fever, hypertension, or flank masses argues against pyelonephritis, cortical necrosis, or stone disease.
